stem: A triangular pyramid has a base that is an equilateral triangle with sides of ${=b}$ cm. The apex is directly above the centre of the base, so its three triangular faces are identical, and each has a slant height of ${=s}$ cm (the height of the triangle, measured from the apex at right angles to a base edge). Calculate the total surface area of the pyramid, correct to 1 decimal place, in $\text{cm}^{2}$.
solution: The surface is the equilateral triangle base plus three identical triangular faces, so $\text{surface area}=\text{area of base}+3\times\text{area of one face}$.
To find the area of the base we need its perpendicular height $h_b$. It splits the base into two right-angled triangles, each with hypotenuse ${=b}$ cm and one short side $\frac{{=b}}{2}={=m}$ cm.
By the theorem of Pythagoras: $h_b^{2}={=b}^{2}-{=m}^{2}={=b*b}-{=m*m}={=b*b-m*m}$, so $h_b=\sqrt{{=b*b-m*m}}={=m}\sqrt{3}\approx{=fixed(m*sqrt(3), 3)}$ cm.
Area of the base: $\frac{1}{2}\times b\times h_b=\frac{1}{2}\times{=b}\times{=m}\sqrt{3}={=m*m}\sqrt{3}\approx{=fixed(m*m*sqrt(3), 3)}\text{ cm}^{2}$.
Area of the three faces: $3\times\frac{1}{2}\times b\times h_s=3\times\frac{1}{2}\times{=b}\times{=s}={=3*m*s}\text{ cm}^{2}$.
Add the areas: $\text{surface area}={=m*m}\sqrt{3}+{=3*m*s}\approx{=fixed(m*m*sqrt(3), 3)}+{=3*m*s}\approx{=fixed(X, 3)}$, which is ${=fixed(X, 1)}\text{ cm}^{2}$ correct to 1 decimal place.
notes: Modelled on worked example 8 (we08: base 6 cm, face height 10 cm, answer 9*sqrt(3) + 90 = 105.6). The book solution is exact-then-round, which is what this does. The base side is 2m with m in {3, 4, 5} so that half of it is whole and h_b = m*sqrt(3). m = 6 and 8 were left out deliberately: m^2*sqrt(3) lies within 0.005 of a rounding boundary (62.354, 110.851) and a blind solver rounding sqrt(3) early could land on the other side. For m in {3, 4, 5} the unrounded value is at least 0.037 from a boundary, so rounding h_b to 2 or 3 decimal places first gives the same 1-decimal answer (checked: 15.588, 27.713, 43.301 for the base). Answers range from 69.6 to 313.3.
